units.rawText: (Sigh) To think his first movie would be one of your works. This kid is really unfortunate, in more ways than one.

units.rawText: Your reviews are the real boilerplate rubbish here! You fake neutrality with an objective tone, then twist the plot and distort the facts to slander the script... It's the exact same process each time!
units.displayText: Your reviews are the real boilerplate rubbish here! You fake neutrality with an objective tone, then twist the plot and distort the facts to slander the script... It's the exact same process each time!

units.rawText: Well, it's not like I can help it, given the lack of variety in all the flaws you reveal.

units.rawText: Also, it's not "distorting the facts", as there's a basis for every word I say.
